brand.name: KRISHIBONDHU
brand.tagline: AI-Powered Smart Agriculture & Farmer Assistance Platform
brand.subtagline: Empowering farmers with instant crop disease detection, localized agronomy AI, live weather advisories, and precision farm records.

landing.heroBadge: Dedicated Agritech Platform for Bengal & India
landing.heroTitle: Smarter Farming, Healthier Crops, Higher Yields
landing.heroDescription: Take a photo of any crop leaf to diagnose diseases instantly, chat with an agronomy AI in your own language, and access precision weather advisories tailored to your soil.
landing.guestNote: No credit card or registration needed to scan or explore.
landing.featuresTitle: Built for Real Indian Farming Realities
landing.featuresSubtitle: High performance on low-end devices, low data consumption, and vernacular language support.
landing.feature1Desc: Upload or snap a leaf photo. Multimodal vision detects disease, severity, organic & chemical treatments, and warns when image is uncertain.
landing.feature2Desc: Consult with a smart AI trained on ICAR and state agricultural university knowledge in Bengali, Hindi, or English.
landing.feature3Desc: Real-time agro-meteorological forecasting with spray windows, heavy rain warnings, and irrigation timing.
landing.feature4Desc: Log your exact N-P-K tests, manage multiple plots in Bigha, Katha or Acres, and track yield trends over seasons.
landing.step1Desc: Take a close-up photo of an affected leaf in bright natural light.
landing.step2Desc: Our backend vision model analyzes symptoms, lesion patterns, and weather factors.
landing.step3Desc: Receive step-by-step organic remedies, safe chemical dosages, and prevention tips.
landing.pilotNotice: Piloted for Public Good & Academic Agricultural Extension. Advisory guidance only.
